snippet.title: I'm Cooking a new Fangan Translation~
snippet.description:
Next video will be longer and premiered, this is an intro of what this game shows, and it's very good.
YEAH NO THE TITLE OF THIS FANGAN IS TOO LONG FOR THIS VIDEO SO I'M TRYING TO BE SMART HERE AND GATHER SOME PEOPLE CUZ YT BEING STINKY ABOUT LIKES/SUBS = COUNTS PER VIEW (????).
*Ahem* now with my silly rant out of the way, this Fangame is called Danganronpa Delusion : The Front Line of Despair and Reinterpreted Hope (Man, people are really like to make interesting titles these years huh...)
Only the prologue is out in korean since 2023 and this one actually doesn't seem to have lot of interaction with their community (At least on Twitter) which made me curious as to check this one while i'm still drawing/translating/fixing DR Minus.

Anyways thanks for watching guys! I'll be sure to have this prologue ready this month! 
💖Link of the creator's Twitter: https://x.com/NNBcola as well as some art made by them!
💚Patreon :https://www.patreon.com/Zephirum
🤎The Ko-fi channel! :https://ko-fi.com/zephirum 
💜Discord Server : https://discord.gg/vE9AMGAunS
